data.name: Hamdiyah
data.gender_notes: Hamdiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who is thankful and appreciative. Derived from the Arabic root 'hmd', meaning to praise or be thankful. The name Hamdiyah carries the meaning “Praiser, Grateful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hamdiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody praiser, grateful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes gratitude and appreciation towards Allah and His blessings.
data.etymology: Hamdiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praiser, Grateful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hamdiyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

It suggests a woman who is deeply thankful for the blessings she has received, both material and spiritual. This name can serve as an inspiration for women to cultivate a deep sense of gratitude and develop a positive attitude towards life.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name Hamdiyah holds great significance as it encourages women to remember Allah's blessings in their lives and to offer their thanks and praise regularly. It also serves as a reminder to be grateful for the simple things and to find joy and contentment in them. Furthermore, the name Hamdiyah can help foster a deep sense of gratitude for the ultimate blessing of being a creation of Allah and being able to worship Him.
